title: work/working go/going do/doing
summary: Какую форму глагола ставить после других слов: **work** (после can, will, do), **to work** (после want, going) или **working** (после am/is/are, was/were).
ru:
## Три формы глагола
У многих глаголов в предложении встречаются три формы: **work**, **to work** и **working**. Какую выбрать — зависит от слова, которое стоит перед глаголом.

## 1. Просто глагол: work / go / be
Так бывает после модальных глаголов (**will, can, could, must, should, might, would, shall, may**) и после **do / does / did**.
> Ann **will be** here soon. — Анна скоро будет здесь.
> I **can't meet** you tomorrow. — Не смогу встретиться завтра.
> You **should go** to bed. — Тебе стоит лечь спать.
> **Do** you **work** here? — Ты здесь работаешь?
> We **didn't sleep** well. — Мы плохо спали.
После этих слов **to не нужно**.

## 2. to work / to go / to be
Используем после: **going to**, **have to**, **want to**, **would like to**, **used to**.
> I'm **going to play** tennis tomorrow. — Я собираюсь играть в теннис.
> I **have to go** now. — Мне пора идти.
> Do you **want to go** out? — Хочешь выйти?
> I'd **like to talk** to you. — Я хотел бы поговорить.
> Dave **used to work** in a factory. — Дейв раньше работал на фабрике.

## 3. working / going / playing
Используем после **am / is / are** (Present Continuous) и **was / were** (Past Continuous).
> Please be quiet. I'**m working**. — Тише, я работаю.
> What **were** you **doing** when the phone rang? — Что ты делал, когда зазвонил телефон?

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I can to swim.~~ → I **can swim**.
- ~~She doesn't works.~~ → She doesn't **work**.
- ~~I want go home.~~ → I want **to go** home.
- ~~He is work now.~~ → He is **working** now.
- ~~Did you went?~~ → Did you **go**?
en:
## Three forms of the verb
A verb can be **work**, **to work** or **working**. The word before it tells us which form to use.

## 1. The verb alone: work / go / be
We use it after modal verbs (**will, can, could, must, should, might, would, shall, may**) and after **do / does / did**.
> Ann **will be** here soon.
> I **can't meet** you tomorrow.
> You **should go** to bed.
> **Do** you **work** here?
> We **didn't sleep** well.
We don't use **to** after these words.

## 2. to work / to go / to be
We use it after **going to**, **have to**, **want to**, **would like to** and **used to**.
> I'm **going to play** tennis tomorrow.
> I **have to go** now.
> Do you **want to go** out?
> I'd **like to talk** to you.
> Dave **used to work** in a factory.

## 3. working / going / playing
We use it after **am / is / are** (present continuous) and **was / were** (past continuous).
> Please be quiet. I'**m working**.
> What **were** you **doing** when the phone rang?

## Common mistakes
- ~~I can to swim.~~ → I **can swim**.
- ~~She doesn't works.~~ → She doesn't **work**.
- ~~I want go home.~~ → I want **to go** home.
- ~~He is work now.~~ → He is **working** now.
structure:
## Какая форма после какого слова
| Перед глаголом | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| will, shall, can, could, may, might, must, should, would | глагол (work) | She can swim. |
| do, does, did | глагол (work) | Do you know him? |
| going to, have to, want to, would like to, used to | to + глагол | I want to go. |
| am, is, are | глагол + -ing | He is cooking. |
| was, were | глагол + -ing | We were sleeping. |

## Отрицание и вопрос
| Форма | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| will + work | won't work | Will you work? |
| to work | don't want to work | Do you want to work? |
| is working | isn't working | Is he working? |

## Памятка
> После **модальных** и **do/does/did** — глагол без to.
> После **want / going / have / would like / used** — **to** + глагол.
> После **be** (am/is/are, was/were) — глагол с **-ing**.

exercises.title: Выберите форму глагола
exercises.instruction: Вставьте глагол в скобках в правильной форме: **go**, **to go** или **going**.

items.text: I want {{to see}} the new film. (see)
They are {{playing}} football in the park. (play)
I'm going {{to buy}} a new bike. (buy)
Would you like {{to come}} with us? (come)
When I was a child, I used {{to live}} in a village. (live)

items.why: После did — глагол в основной форме.

items.q: We ___ to the cinema when it started to rain.
items.why: Действие в процессе в прошлом — was/were + -ing.

items.q: Как сказать «Мне не следует есть много»?
options: I shouldn't to eat a lot.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение из слов в скобках. Глагол поставьте в правильную форму.

items.prompt: (they / go / to the cinema / now) — Present Continuous
answers: They are going to the cinema now.
They're going to the cinema now.
Did you do your homework yesterday?

items.prompt: (he / not / have / a car) — отрицание, Present Simple
answers: He does not have a car.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: What do you want to do at the weekend?
items.sample: I want to visit my friends.

items.prompt: What are you going to do tomorrow?
items.sample: I'm going to go to work and then play tennis.
I worked, cooked dinner and watched a film.
